title: Annual and change-triggered independent penetration testing
objective: An independent firm tests Unbound before production data is loaded, at least annually thereafter, and after material architecture, hosting or integration changes.
implementing_systems: External penetration testing firm (not yet engaged)
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Architecture-informed scope including structural-claim bypass
objective: Testers receive threat models, rule catalog and residual attack surfaces and are tasked to bypass structural controls (SEC-DB-001, SEC-UI-002, SEC-AUTH-001), tenant isolation, financial workflow invariants and AI agent tool authority, without suppressing independent discovery.
implementing_systems: External penetration testing firm (not yet engaged)
Tutela (threat and invariant model source; not yet applied to Unbound)

title: Qualified, accredited and independent testers
objective: Testing firms are independent of Echelon engineering, hold a recognized accreditation, and assign testers with relevant certifications; firms are rotated or re-evaluated at least every three engagements.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Pen test findings tracked to remediation and independent retest
objective: Every finding enters the vulnerability register under VUL SLAs, receives a regression test or structural fix, and is retested by the testing firm before being reported as closed.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Customer-initiated testing program
objective: Customers may test a dedicated tenant with synthetic data under published rules of engagement; findings are triaged under VUL SLAs.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Continuous first-party adversarial testing
objective: Adversarial, negative and property-based tests against financial invariants and structural controls run on every release, authored independently of the code author, and are labeled first-party.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)
residual_risks: First-party tests share the builders' assumptions and cannot substitute for independent testing.
